title: MitigationState
description: State tracker for an OriginPoint's mitigation progress. This is a Tracker object in the Event/Tracker/Evaluator separation — it reads OriginPoint (created by a SweepEvent) and updates independently as price moves, rather than OriginPoint and Mitigation importing each other directly. See Domain_Model/Event_Model.md.

origin_point_id.description: The OriginPoint this tracker is watching.

approach_depth.description: AKA fill_ratio: percentage of the zone covered, measured from the entry side toward the far side. 0=barely touched, 1.0=fully reached the far boundary. Can exceed 1.0 if price fully clears through. Mirror image of the person's own high=1/low=0 convention (fill_ratio = 1 - their_level).

zone_width_type.description: Which entry threshold applies: single_candle origin zones need fill_ratio>=0.25 to MEET_THRESHOLD; widened_block (e.g. 15m refinement per Origin Point Detection) needs fill_ratio>=0.50. See Mitigation.md Calibration Evidence.

meets_threshold.description: True once fill_ratio crosses the applicable threshold for zone_width_type. This is the actionable signal, not just approach_depth alone.

mitigated_via.description: Both are terminal MITIGATED per Mitigation.md; tracked here for future use even though not currently distinguished downstream.

observability.description: approach_depth is CALCULATED; the claim this reflects a real leftover position being closed is INFERRED.
